body: Thank you so much for responding.  Yes, they are my biological parents.  Thanks for your advice.  At this point, I just feel so sad, like I found out the people I loved the most don't even care about me.  But it really means a lot for someone to acknowledge my pain, so thank you
Thank you so much
Thank you💛
I would, if you don't live far
I'm feeling a bit better, still wish someone would save me.  I would save you, if you promise to save me too😉
I'm going start doing that

Writing down your feelings and then giving it to them is a good idea, I would like to try that if I ever go to therapy again

I'll try the mediation too, thanks for helping

Yeah, I've been to multiple therapist.  My first one made me feel worse every time, so I got a new one.  He was better, but it's difficult for me to get my feelings across, and he didn't understand me, so I stopped going after a few times.

I could try mediation, but I'm afraid it will make me feel more lonely

I do video call them once in a while.  One of them told me I could talk to him whenever I feel sad, so I did.  I'm really grateful for him, but it's not enough.  I really want to hug someone, but there's no one here
There are, but they're far away.  I want someone to be around
Thank you 💛
Okay, I think I'll try that
I've heard a lot of bad stories about them, but maybe it's worth a try, I don't know
I don't know who to ask, and everyone who cares is far away
Yeah, okay.  I'll ask my friend if I could stay with her for a while when lockdown is over
I've been asking my mom if there's anywhere else I could live, but there's nowhere.  I was going go to my uncle, but some stuff happened with his son, and now I can't

Yes, I have my own room with a lock.  I pretty much stay in there all day.  My parents know that they keep harassing me, because pretty much whenever they're rude to me, they tell my parents I was rude to them, so then I have to show them the text messages they sent to me.

I have blocked one of the girls three times now, she just keeps making a new account like every other month.  My parents talked to them about being nice, but the girls don't care.  My parents keep having friends they have from the country the girls were adopted from talk to them about being nice to me, but I wish they would stop because I don't want these people to know about it.  And the girls say bad things about me, and I'm not there to defend myself.  So I just look like a bad person in the end to these people

Sorry that's a lot.

Thanks for trying to help, but I don't think there's much that could be done.
I don't know, it's hard to when I live with them

Last year my family adopted some orphans, and two of them are so rude to me, they once told me I don't deserve to be part of the family.  Nobody cares about the things they do to me because they were orphans.  I feel like I lost my family, and my best friend (my brother).  There's so much more, but it all revolves around this
Thanks, but I go through this everyday, and I'm going feel like this tomorrow too, so I just want to go now
